title: RASIER PACIFIC PTY LTD (Uber) — crawled relationships
source_passage: RASIER PACIFIC PTY LTD (ABN 27 622 365 833) is an Australian entity of Uber. It filed a joint modern slavery statement with PORTIER PACIFIC PTY LTD, UBER AUSTRALIA HOLDINGS PTY LTD and UBER AUSTRALIA PTY LTD for the reporting period 2021. In August 2021 Uber Eats partnered with Woolworths Group to deliver same-hour groceries from Woolworths Metro stores, and Uber provided last-mile delivery for Woolworths.com.au orders. Uber Eats competed with Deliveroo in Australian food delivery; Uber Eats held 52.9 percent market share while Deliveroo held 11.7 percent, and Deliveroo exited Australia in November 2022. PricewaterhouseCoopers is the independent auditor of Uber Technologies. BWS and Dan Murphy's, operated by Endeavour Group, use DoorDash and Menulog for third-party delivery rather than Uber Eats.
